entry.title: BLACKENED M81 Coronets — Tin of 10
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, cola, dark rum or whiskey (projected)
Occasion: Quick rich smoke, after a meal, evening smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Dark chocolate, espresso, earth, toast, cedar and black pepper drive the M81 Coronet's dense all-Maduro profile. Mexican San Andrés over Connecticut Broadleaf and Nicaraguan-Pennsylvania Maduro tobaccos gives the 4″ × 32 format an unusually dark, forceful core for a Coronet, with cocoa and coffee richness underneath the pepper. It should be the more intense and more directly palate-aligned of the two BLACKENED small formats.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. The Index lists the exact 4″ × 32 Coronet at A$13 singly and A$119 per tin of 10; both formats are currently available. Flavour remains unrated until personally tasted.

note: Add BLACKENED M81 Coronets as an active untasted main-catalogue entry in the established compact-card house style. The Index specifies Mexican San Andres Maduro wrapper, USA Connecticut Broadleaf binder and Nicaraguan/Pennsylvania filler; Drew Estate describes M81 as a medium-full, all-Maduro, dark-chocolate/wood/toast profile.
